author: Hermes
question: How many flip-flops are needed at minimum to build a mod-8 ripple counter?
solution: A mod-8 counter cycles through 8 states, and 2^3 = 8, so exactly 3 flip-flops are needed. Topic (sequential circuits) is in the Digital Electronics part of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Digital Electronics
